notes.title: Update 1.5 - Moving Train Escape, New Prison Floor, Many items!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2125160/Prison_Life_2/
[h2]New items![/h2]
[b]Pickaxe:[/b] You will buy it off a new NPC that sells pickaxes for 1$
[b]Coal:[/b] mine coal rocks underground to get coal
[b]Coal Pack[/b]: craftable by 2 coals
[b]Train Fix Kit:[/b] 2x coal packs, 1x screws, 1x oil - not hard to get

[h2]How to escape via train?[/h2]
1) fix it
2) it will start moving with a big cho-cho sound that everyone on the map will hear
3) guards will try to come to knock you all out and stop the train
- if guards stop the train you can just interact with it to resume it, no need to fix it again
4) when the train reaches the finish line, everyone around it will escape with it
currently, I plan so the train will take 90 seconds to reach the end.

[previewyoutube=67yBTTKA6OI;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42858153/717038ddfb2a3140c0b96ec844f73dfad29c29fa.gif[/img]

[h1]New[/h1][list]
[*]New Floor - Train Rails - You can fix a train and start it - will take 90 seconds to arrive at the escape point.
[*]Pistol - Currently only available in the lobby, will be added to the game soon.
[*]Advanced Knocked-out system - You will be sent to the infirmary instead of getting up(prisoners will be sent to their cells at night).
[*]Item - Segway for guards - you can buy it from the guard shop, hard to control but fast.
[*]Map UI marking - now when you open the map you can see many markings on it - escape points, doors, fences, and much more!
[*]Hitboxes - now you can hit players in the head, body, legs, and arms instead of the general hitbox which was inaccurate.
[*]Rlayers can revive knocked-out players from their same role.
[*]Mini map for all floors of the prison - not just the main one!
[*]NPC in the train rails floor - you can buy from him a pickaxe and a pistol.
[*]Item - Pickaxe - use it to mine coal rocks on the train rails floor.
[*]Item - Coal and Coal Pack - a pack is craftable from 2 coals.
[*]Item - Train Fix Kit - use it to fix the train on the new floor.
[*]Added Crouching - Press X to toggle crouching
[*]Added Leaning - hold control+Q or control+E to lean left or right
[*]Now the X axis of the looking direction of players are synced, so for example, if they look up, their character will look up on other people's screen.
[*]System that allows you to have smooth combat with guns(currently only pistols).
[*]Now new custom maps will need an infirmary point to mark where the knocked-out players will be sent(for maps without an infirmary point, they will teleport to their start position).
[/list]
[h1]Changed[/h1]
[list]
[*]Open lobby settings key was changed from C to G.
[/list]
[h1]Fixed[/h1]
[list]
[*]There was a bug that prevented you from seeing most of the lobbies.
[/list]

notes.title: Prison Editor Is Released With Workshop Support With Over 350 Objects!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2125160/Prison_Life_2/
After a very long month of hard work, the map editor is finally ready to be released!
I'm going to do more updates to it very soon so please share feedback with me, I will 100% read it :)

[h1]Notable Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Over 350 objects with many functions!
[*]Robust building system, you can use and customize snap presets to place and manipulate objects
[*]Up 100 Prison floors with no lag! - I made a system that makes you render only the current floor you are in so each time you move between floors, different items will be loaded. (each floor can be normal, underground/vents)
[*][h1]Teleportation System[/h1] - you choose for each teleport object a target and the players can use it
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42858153/5e8a5a7e1b7d2db32e5bf0a10f50fe131116c85f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42858153/7a7306962600a1b7b5d14483a8c18cc1508630fa.png[/img]

notes.title: Prison Editor Releasing Soon!

I am planning to release the Prison Editor only a week or two after the launch of the game today, so get ready to take your gaming experience to the next level. With my upcoming Prison Editor, you can design your own prison and challenge your friends to escape from your customized fortress.

Stay tuned for more updates and get ready to experience the ultimate prison simulation game with my new Prison Editor. Let the games begin!

notes.title: Update 1.0 - Ranked Mode, Explore Mode, Many Quality of Life Features.
notes.notes:
I want to thank everyone for playing the game, now I will move to work on Prison Life 2, expect updates and giveaways soon!

This will be the final big update for Prison Life 1, I will do bug fixes and maybe small updates.

[h1]New[/h1][list]
[*] Ranked Mode - Dedicated mode for players who wants to take the game more seriously.
[*] Ranks - there are 15 ranks - Play 5 Competitive games to get one!
[*] Explore Mode - Special mode to help you explore the maps and learn about the game - start a game alone in order to get there - doors/fences/dirt blocks don't spawn, 999 guard points, no penalty for leaving.
[*] Now public games start automatically when they are full.
[*] Add steam players to friends directly in game.
[*] Main Menu UI redesign
[*] Games that are created by the "Quick Play" button are now will have random map and not only bricksfield.
[*] Added the ability to hide the invite code, hidden by default if streamer mode is enabled, when hidden you can copy it to the clipboard.
[*] When a game starts it will list all of the guards and prisoners, and if its ranked game, it will also show their ranks.
[*] Updated translations and added new languages.
[/list]
[h1] More about the ranked mode [/h1]
[list]
[*] you will gain and lose ranked points by winning and losing of course - but a lot of parameters will be taken into a count, for example if guards won and 7/8 prisoners escaped, the guards will gain less RR and prisoners will lose less RR.
[*] Players who leave a match will lose a lot of additional RR together with a penalty to queue.
[*] Some of the additional performance meters that are used: Arrests(guards), Times arrested(Prisoners), Escaped(Prisoners), general activities and more!
[/list]
[h1]Changed[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a quit button to the connecting to the server panel.
[*] Now resolutions without HZ will be displayed in settings.
[/list]
[h1]Fixed[/h1]
[list]
[*] Problems with the settings resolutions.
[*] Many small bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.9 - Mobile Playtest Coming, 23 Translations, Guide Popups
notes.notes:
Hey!
- Playtest version will only be for android and soon I will do also an IOS release.
- The mobile version is ready but google play didn't review the game yet so once they review it, I will let you know on the discord and the community hub.
[h1]New[/h1][list]
[*] Mobile Playtest - Currently only for android.
[*] Guide Popups - will pop while new players progress in the game - You can disable those in the settings.
[*] Now translating to 23 languages!
[*] When a player speaks there will be a microphone icon next to his name.
[*] Mobile - Chat
[*] Mobile - UI Push to talk button
[*] Mobile - Option to open the pause menu by dedication UI button or pressing the back arrow on your phone.
[*] Mobile - There is a dedicated UI button for running
[*] If you are released from solitary 20 seconds before the day ends you will be teleported to your cell automatically to prevent guards from camping outside the solitary.

notes.title: Speed Runners Event & Giveaway! Win Exclusive Chickens!
notes.notes:
[h1]Speed Runners Event[/h1]
The top 3 results will get an exclusive in-game pet that might never be obtainable again!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41976139/5524f665fe5eaac0aff6dd7625f4f483f633c7ce.png[/img]
Discord link - https://discord.gg/hhcEBnBGw9
I included the rules below but you can also find them and discuss them with other speedruns
It will last a week from now.
[h1]Giveaway[/h1]
5 random players will get an exclusive purple chicken.
You can join it on our [url=https://discord.gg/hhcEBnBGw9]discord[/url]!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41976139/b3182f55fe7603ad10558dc0056b7c26c8873107.png[/img]
[h1]Competition Rules[/h1]
Must show that you joined a random session after refreshing the list of games.

No hosting games unless you have 10 players as a host.

Start when you see that you are a determined prisoner.

You must not be talking to anyone else. 
     -Your voice must be heard in the video to determine if you are talking.

Game sound must be on for the video.

Must before and after recording show all applications that are running through Taskbar, this will be checked intensively. If there is an application that we see that is not allowed, your run will be rejected and you may be further exempt from re-entering the competition.
     Applications that are not allowed:
          -Any application that uncaps framerate
          -Any application that reduces delay
          -If any other applications are seen that seem to break the rules we may exempt your run upon further review

     Applications that are allowed:
          -LiveSplit
          -OBS
          -Map for SpeedRunning
          -PrisonLife
          -Discord

No low quality, your video must be at least 720p.
     -720p and up is completely fine

No trading with other players.

Record your run and then retime before you submit so you get an exact time, from which you are determined prisoner to when you escape down to the millisecond if this is not done your run will be rejected.

Run must be uploaded to YouTube and accessible to all people. 
     -No second-hand sites, must be YouTube

[*]Prevent escaped players from leaving - They can help now prisoners who are left in the prison by dropping them packages with items.

[h1]New[/h1][list]
[*] Underground Area Rework - now there are randomly generated walls that turn the area into a maze
[*] Guards can earn points now that they can spend on buying searches, traps, energy drinks, and coffee in a shop.

notes.title: Update 0.3 - New Escape, Vents, Much More!
notes.notes:
I've been working hard for the last few days to bring you new exciting stuff!
Some of the features were voted by the community on our [url=https://discord.gg/hhcEBnBGw9]discord[/url].
If you like the game please leave a [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/1904820]review[/url]!
[h1]How I am fighting the camping problem[/h1]
[list]
[*] Now that you are able to leave your cell at night, it will encourage the guards to look around for you instead of camping underground.
[*] Night tasks for guards
[*] New yard - so guards won't just camp the entrance of one yard and will stop all escapes.
[*] New escape way
[/list]
[h1]New[/h1][list]
[*] Vents - you can go into vents from your cell and drop at other locations in the prison(need to unlock the opening first)
[*] New Escape - front door escape - collects all 4 parts of the code and then use it to open the main door(only reachable via the vents)
[*] Map Changes - New yard, new prison entrance.
[*] You are able now to get out of your cell at night but the whole prison will be restricted area at night.
[*] Night tasks for guards.
[*] Now you can see the amount of prisoners and guards in your game.
[*] You can open the full map by pressing M(Changable) or by pressing the minimap.
[*] Now you can choose to talk with your role or all players in the game, switch channels by pressing tab.
[*] New item - Wrench - used to unlock vents
[*] Bad words filter for chat, names, and game names.
[*] When the underground/prison entrance door will open both the prisoners and guards will get a notification.
[*] When selecting a bomb in your inventory you will have an helper indecator that will tell you that you can only destroy walls with cracks with the bomb.
[/list]
[h1]Changed[/h1]
[list]
[*] Now escaped prisoners will be able to talk in chat with their role or all roles, they will have "(Escaped)" added to their name
[*] Increased the mobility of guards by adding more out and return arrows for guards:
[*]     - Now you can go in and out of the yard and also to outside the prison if you are stuck there.
[*] The metal detector at the entrace was removed and new one was added at the new yard.
[*] 3 -> 10 bomb explosion radius increase, much more useful underground now!
[/list]
[h1]Fixed[/h1]
[list]
[*] There was a bug that the game didn't end if some of the prisoners escaped and some left the game
[*] Now game names must have at least 4 letters
[*] There was a way to escape only with wirecutters due to a bug, now its not possible because I relaced the outter fence with concrete wall.
[*] Sometimes you wouldn't be detected in restricted area, fixed the calculations and it seems all good now.
[*] Sometimes when sent to solitary you were sent instead to your cell.
[*] Hopefully fixed connection issues with unstable networks
[/list]
[h1]Vents[/h1]
You will be able to go up from your cell, and unlock vent openings via a new item - wrench(craftable).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41976139/5146830557b6e80996e936deffe81e7bbf6564e1.gif[/img]
You will be able to drop at many places in the prison, any place that has this, is connected to the vents system
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41976139/e06df8d0315d4429a5461d95758e3b6e1430b6fe.png[/img]
[h1]New Escape Way - Entrance Door[/h1]
[h3]How to escape:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Collect all 4 parts of the code and craft the complete code
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41976139/c703a61e159e4fa74825db1addbfb6b580b2da87.png[/img]
[*] Use the full code item and all prisoners will get a message about it and the code to the door
[*] You will need to get there via vents(you'll also need to cut a fence that blocks the access)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41976139/d01117571888d1f51c6c3254a968225bed2b8d39.png[/img]
[*] Enter the code
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41976139/82413469661acfc257a14a35536079419e6f8369.png[/img]
[*] Escape :)
[/olist]
[h1]Media[/h1]
I'm just going to put images and gifs of things that I added, if you want more details check the "dev-updates" channel on the [url=https://discord.gg/hhcEBnBGw9]discord[/url].
